claims.text: The United States moved to force the divestiture or ban of TikTok due to national-security concerns, specifically the potential for Chinese government access to US user data and the platform's algorithm [Source: ev-1].
This concern was formalized through CFIUS review and the "Project Texas" initiative, which aimed to host US user data in Oracle’s cloud under US control [Source: ev-1].

Legislatively, President Biden signed the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act on 2024-04-24, mandating that ByteDance divest TikTok’s US operations within roughly 270 days (extendable by an additional 90 days) or face a ban [Source: ev-1].
